notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.
